items.raw: 'An exchange publishes the TOTAL size resting at a price, never the individual orders inside it - so nobody can tell you that one trader cancelled one order. What is measured here is the money: when it appeared at this price, whether it has grown or shrunk since, and how many of the five books are quoting it. Any of it can be withdrawn in a second.'
items.en: An exchange publishes the TOTAL size resting at a price, never the individual orders inside it - so nobody can tell you that one trader cancelled one order. What is measured here is the money: when it appeared at this price, whether it has grown or shrunk since, and how many of the five books are quoting it. Any of it can be withdrawn in a second.
items.es: Un exchange publica el tamaño TOTAL en espera a un precio, nunca las órdenes individuales dentro de él - así que nadie puede decirte que un trader canceló una orden. Lo que se mide aquí es el dinero: cuándo apareció a este precio, si ha crecido o disminuido desde entonces, y cuántos de los cinco libros lo están cotizando. Cualquier parte de él puede retirarse en un segundo.

items.en: A price carrying far more resting money than the prices either side of it - at least two and a half times the middling neighbour, and never under $250,000. Measured against its own book, so it means the same thing on Bitcoin as on a small coin.
items.es: Un precio que acumula mucho más dinero en espera que los precios a cada lado - al menos dos veces y media el vecino intermedio, y nunca por debajo de $250,000. Medido contra su propio libro, así que significa lo mismo en Bitcoin que en una moneda pequeña.

items.en: The tape executed through that price while the money stood there - somebody actually bought or sold it, and the level is spent. Marked with a plus.
items.es: La cinta se ejecutó a través de ese precio mientras el dinero estaba ahí - alguien realmente compró o vendió, y el nivel está gastado. Marcado con un más.

items.raw: 'One line of the picture, covering a slice of price. The slice is sized so that about sixty rows cover the part of the book that really exists, which on a major coin is a quarter of one percent either side.'
items.en: One line of the picture, covering a slice of price. The slice is sized so that about sixty rows cover the part of the book that really exists, which on a major coin is a quarter of one percent either side.
items.es: Una línea de la imagen, cubriendo una porción de precio. La porción está dimensionada para que unas sesenta filas cubran la parte del libro que realmente existe, que en una moneda principal es un cuarto de uno por ciento a cada lado.

items.raw: 'How many of the five exchanges have money at that price. One book alone can vanish in a blink; four books agreeing is a different object entirely.'
items.en: How many of the five exchanges have money at that price. One book alone can vanish in a blink; four books agreeing is a different object entirely.
items.es: Cuántos de los cinco exchanges tienen dinero a ese precio. Un solo libro puede desaparecer en un parpadeo; cuatro libros coincidiendo es un objeto completamente distinto.

items.raw: 'Which side has had more money waiting, averaged over the whole window rather than this second. A book is lopsided all day at small numbers; a lasting lean is the one worth reading.'
items.en: Which side has had more money waiting, averaged over the whole window rather than this second. A book is lopsided all day at small numbers; a lasting lean is the one worth reading.
items.es: Qué lado ha tenido más dinero esperando, promediado sobre toda la ventana en vez de este segundo. Un libro está desequilibrado todo el día en números pequeños; una inclinación duradera es la que vale la pena leer.

items.raw: 'Limit orders sitting in the book, unspent. It is a fact about this second and never a promise: any of it can be cancelled before price reaches it.'
items.en: Limit orders sitting in the book, unspent. It is a fact about this second and never a promise: any of it can be cancelled before price reaches it.
items.es: Órdenes límite reposando en el libro, sin usar. Es un hecho sobre este segundo y nunca una promesa: cualquier parte puede cancelarse antes de que el precio la alcance.
